name: psilink-install-policy-probe
description: Fixture the Dockerfile's install prelude dry-run-installs to measure whether the allowScripts install policy is actually in force. It declares an install script that no allowScripts verdict covers, so npm must refuse it with ESTRICTALLOWSCRIPTS; if npm accepts it, the policy is off and the build fails. The dry run never executes the script. Recording a verdict for this package would defeat the probe, which scripts/dockerfile-freeze.test.mjs refuses.

scripts.postinstall: echo 'psilink install-policy probe: this script must never run' >&2; exit 1
